summary.headline: EU puts ChatGPT under the DSA's strictest tier; Gatekeeper jumps
summary.body: A bright day for coordination. The European Commission designated ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the Digital Services Act, requiring systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months. Binding cross-border oversight raises Global Coordination and Alignment & Control, which lifts Gatekeeper (nations keeping a lid on runaway AI) and Protector God, and pulls Self-Destruction and Conquerors down. Eight smaller items, many from lower-credibility sources, barely moved things: data-centre protests, Meta's child-safety settlement and NHS AI-scribe errors added Tech Backlash; Andrew Bailey warned the G20 about AI cyber risk. Horizon Balance rose to -4.45, the best reading in two weeks.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper +1.0, Self-Destruction -0.6 and Protector God +0.4, almost entirely from the EU's DSA designation of ChatGPT (+0.99, -0.70, +0.35).
coming_up: ChatGPT must deliver DSA systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months

events.title: EU designates ChatGPT a Very Large Online Search Engine under the DSA
events.summary: The European Commission placed ChatGPT (with Reddit and Roblox) under the DSA's strictest tier, requiring systemic-risk assessments, mitigation and researcher data access within four months.
events.reason: First binding EU systemic-risk regime applied to a frontier chatbot.

events.title: Data-center backlash: Trump warns holdouts as ~$130B of projects face protests
events.summary: Trump warned communities rejecting data centres would fall behind China, while Sam Altman acknowledged 'people hate data centers' with about $130B of projects facing protests, delays or cancellations.
events.reason: Evidence of widespread local opposition; from newsletter digest.

events.title: Meta to pay up to $18B to settle multistate child-safety suits
events.summary: Meta agreed to pay up to $18 billion over a decade to settle state child-safety lawsuits and add default teen usage limits.
events.reason: Major tech accountability outcome; mostly social media, so T1. Source is a digest.

events.title: SB Energy plans 10GW Ohio AI campus, gives OpenAI $5.5B in warrants
events.summary: SoftBank-owned SB Energy granted OpenAI warrants worth about $5.5B with a 20-year lease for a planned 10GW Ohio campus powered mostly by new gas.
events.reason: Further compute scale-up for one lab.

events.title: Bank of England's Bailey warns G20 frontier AI is changing cyber risk
events.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey told G20 finance ministers that frontier AI could change financial-sector cyber risk.

events.title: UK opens first competitions in £100M sovereign AI procurement scheme
events.summary: The UK launched the first competitions under a £100M programme to buy AI from domestic firms.

events.title: China state-media-linked account rebukes Anthropic before US-China AI talks
events.summary: A CCTV-linked account criticised Anthropic ahead of planned US-China AI talks.
events.reason: Hostile rhetoric before bilateral talks; minor.

events.title: NHS watchdog: AI scribes get drug names and diagnoses wrong
events.summary: Healthwatch England reported errors in AI-generated medical records, including a confused drug name and a misreported diagnosis.
events.reason: Public-sector warning on AI reliability in health.

events.title: Thailand's TH-AI Passport national AI-skills platform goes live
events.summary: Thailand launched a national platform giving citizens 15+ access to 33 AI models and 96+ training courses, with free introductory access.
events.reason: Public AI access and reskilling programme; single blog source.
